thread:
Sam: Heads-up: I've got a sketch for operator preflight ordering when doing offline upgrades. thinking about probe order vs eviction windows.
Priya: nice. what problem are we trying to solve exactly?
Sam: Right now some nodes apply delta bundles and then kubelet evicts pods mid-activation because disk pressure spikes. we need a preflight that reserves a 'staging' bucket and a short-lived marker so activation doesn't race with kubelet eviction.
Luca: Could we just increase kubelet eviction thresholds during activation? that sounds invasive for customers.
Priya: yea don't want to rely on cluster-wide changes. operator should be responsible for its staging lifecycle.
Marta: proposal: operator creates a local ephemeral PVC or uses a node-local staging directory and writes a preflight marker with size estimate. kubelet still sees disk usage, but operator then registers the marker with the node agent so the agent can request a transient eviction grace extension from the node admin control plane.
Ken: that agent handshake feels heavy. what about a cheaper heuristic: prefetch only metadata first and stream blobs while keeping active sequence short.
Sam: agree on streaming, but large models still require temporary spike. marker + negotiated grace seems safest for air-gapped where ops can opt-in.
Priya: we need failure modes documented. if the grace isn't granted, operator should abort and roll back the partially-extracted files. also avoid double-activation if an operator process restarts.
Luca: pseudo flow idea:
```
1) operator create-staging-marker(size=N, ttl=10m)
2) node-agent sees marker, marks node "staging-reserved"
3) operator streams blobs into staging dir
4) operator verify checksums
5) operator move staging -> active (atomic rename)
6) node-agent clear marker
```
Marta: include idempotency token on the marker so restarts can reconcile. marker should include a version and a signature from control-plane.
Ken: regarding resource accounting: we should expose a `stagingQuota` field in CRD so admins can limit disk and memory for activations. default conservative value.
Priya: also add `evictionPolicy: defer|allow` in CRD. defer instructs node-agent to request the short grace window when possible. allow means operator does best-effort.
Sam: good. what about timeouts? we should treat a failed move as safe to roll back after TTL + jitter. deletion must be robust to partial writes.
Luca: use a two-phase activation marker: PREPARED and COMMITTED states. PREPARED contains expected manifest, COMMITTED is set only after atomic rename. cleanup looks for stale PREPARED older than TTL.
Marta: edge case: what if operator is mid-rename and powercut kills node? rename may be non-atomic if cross-filesystem. enforce same-fs staging -> active. operator must validate fs layout during preflight.
Ken: add a preflight check that validates: available bytes >= stagingQuota * 1.05, same-filesystem for target path, inode availability. fail early with clear error.
Priya: add observability: events for preflight-pass, preflight-fail, reserve-granted, reserve-denied, activation-commit, rollback. Console can show per-activation timeline.
Sam: billing note: host-local staging will increase transient I/O — may need telemetry flag so we can correlate upgrades with spike charts.
deploy-bot: deploy status: operator-preflight-v0.1 pushed to canary cluster-ops at 1788012360 :rocket:
Ken: last question: how does this work with airgapped installer that delivers seed+delta? seed path may need to be staged first and then deltas applied in-place. marker should allow multi-stage activations.
Sam: plan supports multi-stage: PREPARED can be hierarchical (seed then delta). operator composes a single final COMMITTED transition.
Marta: I'll draft an RFC with CRD fields: stagingQuota, evictionPolicy, markerTTL, idempotencyToken and the node-agent handshake. will include sequence diagrams and failure timelines.
Priya: thanks — add a short checklist for onprem install guides so operators know to enable node-agent or accept allow policy.
Luca: LGTM. small nit: default TTL should be short (5-10m) and backoff on repeated failures.
Sam: cool. I'll put a WIP doc and ping infra for feedback. :thumbsup:
